Re-stat after hashing; if identity changed reject rather than cache stale digest. Hash once per unchanged binary.

details.stage_location: _run_once: after successful _acquire_slot() and before for attempt in range(max_attempts): call _stage_images(img_dir, images) once. 8 slots ×20 MiB =>160 MiB active disk spool excluding orphan backlog.
details.registry: Register str(img_dir) in _active_img_dirs under _active_lock BEFORE os.mkdir(img_dir, 0o700). Stage files os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600); close each descriptor before agy spawn. Clear img["data"]=b"" immediately after writing; metadata size/MIME/name remains. Whole directory lifetime covers every retry.
details.cleanup: finally after all Run consumers closed: shutil.rmtree(img_dir, ignore_errors=True), then remove own str(img_dir) from active set under lock; always release slot. No-slot/launcher-unavailable/disconnect prior to staging: release request buffers and no filesystem artifact. Cleanup error must remain observable without leaking payload; orphan sweep recovers leftovers.
details.spool_error: OSError at mkdir/open/write/close => no CLI spawn, cleanup partial dir and active registry in finally; return state("image_spool_error", "image_spool_error"), HTTP 500 image_spool_error.
details.sweep: _sweep_workspace(cutoff_s: float=3600.0): directories run-* and img-* only; skip entry.is_symlink(); never follow symlinks; skip paths in _active_img_dirs, even active >1h; remove only now - st_mtime > cutoff_s. Registry check and deletion selection must synchronize under _active_lock to avoid check/register race; staging registers before mkdir.
details.memory: No image descriptors remain open during agy run. Clear decoded refs before attempt loop.
